Methodology

Every recommendation starts with the use case.

Our scores and recommendations are built around realistic missions, product specifications, category comparison, owner feedback signals, and clearly labeled editorial methods.

Research Review

Based on product specifications, manufacturer documentation, category comparison, and owner feedback themes. This label does not claim hands-on testing.

Field-Tested Review

Reserved for products evaluated through direct use. These articles should explain the test context, duration, conditions, and limitations.

Spec Analysis

A technical breakdown of materials, weight, dimensions, feature sets, compatibility, and likely use-case fit.

Buying Guide

A decision framework that helps readers understand product categories, tradeoffs, and shortlists without overstating certainty.
